name: Y. Hata & Co. Ltd.
old_description: You focus on your customers, let us worry about finding the highest quality products to benefit your bottom line.
about:
Y. Hata & Co. Ltd. operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, distributing foodservice products across the Hawaiian islands. The company represents a broad portfolio of national and exclusive brands for professional kitchens.

Its catalog spans protein and seafood — including locally sourced Hawaiian items — grocery and beverages, patisserie and confections, non-grocery supplies such as cleaning and disposable goods, and restaurant equipment from dinnerware to warewashing machines. The distributor carries 16 exclusive brands not available elsewhere in Hawaii, alongside a wide selection of industry‑leading labels.

Customers range from independent restaurants and hotel food‑and‑beverage operations to caterers and institutional foodservice buyers. The company highlights locally sourced proteins and a line of eco‑friendly, biodegradable disposables as part of its assortment.

Y. Hata positions its exclusive brand portfolio and local sourcing relationships as key differentiators, aiming to simplify procurement for operators who want both national brands and Hawaii‑specific products from a single supplier.
